name: Skinner v4.0.3 — Weapon Skins Unlocked, Notifications Settings & Refined UI
changelog: Unlocked Weapon Skins: Removed disabled lock on weapon skins tab with keep-alive instant navigation and customizer controls.
New In-App Notifications Settings: Added dedicated Notifications tab with toggle switch to enable or disable toast alerts.
Refined Update Icon: Replaced bell icon on Software Updates with universal refresh/update arrows, dedicating bell to notifications.
Integrated Test Alert Preview: Added instant test notification button in settings to verify alert appearances.
Cryptographic Verification: All update binaries Ed25519-signed and verified via SHA-256 manifests.
